fato_historico: 1963: Hurricane Flora kills 6,000 in Cuba and Haiti.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to find balance amidst shifting winds. Just as the world once faced powerful storms with collective resilience, you may find that your inner light serves as a steady beacon today. Consider how your optimism can heal old wounds and bring fresh clarity to your personal journey as you navigate these gentle transitions.
frase_do_dia: Your spirit is a force of nature that thrives in every season.
significado_numero: Represents the seeker of truth and deep spiritual wisdom.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let your adventurous heart lead the way forward.
